name: memory-engine
description: Queue every Claude Code lifecycle event in a local outbox and deliver it to a memory-engine server, and give the model memory-engine and knowledge-base tools over MCP

me_url.title: memory-engine URL
me_url.description: Base URL of the memory-engine server, such as https://memory.example.net, without a trailing /. Events queue locally until it is set.

kb_url.title: knowledge-base URL
kb_url.description: Base URL of the knowledge-base server, such as https://kb.example.net, without a trailing /. Its tools stay unavailable until it is set.

dev_root.title: Dev root
dev_root.description: Absolute path of this machine's dev root, as its physical path (pwd -P), in printable ASCII without space, quote, percent sign or backslash. Optional.
